page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.16xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated physical cores with 64 vCPUs, utilizing Intel Xeon 8269CY processors running at a baseline frequency of 3.1 GHz. The instance is configured with 256.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance does not include local storage, requiring reliance on external block storage volumes for persistent data. It also lacks integrated GPU hardware accelerators. For network connectivity, the instance delivers a baseline bandwidth of 20 Gbps, facilitating standard multi-node communication and data transfers.

The dedicated CPU allocation model ensures consistent compute performance without resource contention, making it a stable choice for enterprise workloads. The 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio makes this instance suitable for general-purpose applications, web serving, application servers, and moderate database workloads that do not require local high-speed storage or GPU acceleration.
